title: Jury rejects Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI and Altman
summary: A federal jury in Oakland rejected all of Musk's claims against OpenAI, Sam Altman and Microsoft as time-barred, clearing a path for OpenAI's IPO and for-profit structure.
reason: Removes legal obstacle to OpenAI's consolidation and capital raising; verdict reported May 18 (NYT), some outlets say May 19.

title: Anthropic acquires SDK maker Stainless
summary: Anthropic bought Stainless, the startup that builds SDKs for the OpenAI API, Cloudflare and others.
reason: Small acqui-hire of developer tooling used by a rival.

title: Cursor releases Composer 2.5 coding model built on China's Kimi K2.5
summary: Cursor shipped Composer 2.5, built on Moonshot's open-weight Kimi K2.5, claiming parity with Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5 on coding at lower cost.
reason: Open Chinese base model powering a top US coding product; diffusion away from closed labs. Self-reported benchmarks.
